about_the_game:
SOVIETWAVE is an atmospheric arcade driving game set in a retro-futuristic world inspired by the Soviet space dream...
Between endless roads, monumental structures, rocket launches and glowing cities powered by lost technology, each environment explores a unique facet of the Soviet dream, intact, abandoned, or entirely imagined.

This is not a historical recreation, but an artistic vision: a synthwave journey through the cosmic ideal of a vanished empire, suspended between nostalgia, concrete, and stars.


Features:

🚀 Over 15 legendary Soviet vehicles to unlock and customize!

🚀 8 unique Soviet-inspired environments, from ghost towns to cosmic launch sites and frozen wastelands lost in time!

🚀 4 different game modes!

🚀 A retro-futuristic Soviet atmosphere inspired by space exploration and the dreams of a techno-utopia!

🚀 More than 50 exclusive synthwave tracks — cold, cosmic, and deeply nostalgic!

🚀 Upgrade your vehicle’s performance: speed, control, turbo... fine-tune your Soviet machine!

🚀 Unlock new colors, wheels, and accessories to style your cars like never before!

🚀 Dozens of custom skins for each vehicle, inspired by Soviet and cosmic aesthetics!

🚀 New infinite road system with dynamic curves for a more immersive driving experience!

🚀 Smooth and addictive gameplay — easy to pick up, hard to put down!

🚀 A visual and sonic experience soaked in pure nostalgia, between frozen concrete and starlit skies!

“Поехали!”
(“Let’s go!”)
– Yuri Gagarin, April 12, 1961
